title: CWP/15569/2025 of PARAMVIR SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHER
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA
text:
CWP No. 15569 of 2025 1 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 110 CWP No. 15569 of 2025 DATE OF DECISION :- 29.05.2025 Paramvir Singh ...Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA Present:- Mr. Amit Puri, Advocate for the petitioner. DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA , J. (Oral)

1. In the present petition, the petitioner is praying for a direction to the respondents to consider the case of the petitioner for compassionate appointment.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instructions from the petitioner, submits that at this stage, he will be satisfied if a direction is given to respondent No. 3 to decide the representation dated 10.03.2025 (Annexure P-7) submitted by the petitioner, in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion.

4. Mr. Vikas Arora, DAG, Punjab accepts notice on behalf of respondents.

5. In view of the above and without commenting upon the merits of the case, the present petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to authenticity of this order/judgment CWP No. 15569 of 2025 2 respondent No.3 to consider and decide the representation dated 10.03.2025 (Annexure P-7), within a period of 08 weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, in accordance with law. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA ) JUDGE 29.05.2025 P.Singh authenticity of this order/judgment
